428769301.interpretation: S19/59/86 show smooth double-wave without isolated recurring narrow eclipses; fixed-shape fits follow broad structure. Same-FFI custom extraction done; selected event source stack insufficient.

436947190.interpretation: Broad smooth periodic variation across sectors; no convincing discrete repeated eclipses. Same-FFI extraction done; pixel source stack insufficient.

311206604.interpretation: Broad repetitive double wave with flat-ish minima rather than isolated narrow eclipse; rejection is limited to this eclipse claim, and does not exclude ellipsoidal or other binarity. Independent extraction done; no usable selected-event difference stack.

71866523.interpretation: Near-flat S6/33, one very weak candidate and S87 dramatic positive excursion; no convincing repeated eclipse. Same-FFI aperture extraction and attempted difference stack, insufficient event coverage.

92452368.interpretation: S1 cluster of irregular negative points around BTJD 1343 is a single complex episode; later sectors do not securely repeat it. Independent aperture extracted; no fitted-event stack available.

402940895.interpretation: Small depressions occur on strong trends; S103 dominated by severe flux variation. S12 custom extraction fits 0.53% and 0.76% but same photons and baseline-sensitive; narrow eclipse repeat is uncertain. S12 pixel source fit attempted, does not resolve morphology.

94300366.interpretation: Strong irregular variability; two S54 apparent dips, custom extraction depths 4.24% and 4.76%, but baseline and shape vary and S81 is not clean. S54 difference image favors target descriptively; repeated eclipses remain unestablished.

443106429.interpretation: Narrow dips repeat at ~12.796d, two each S11/65 and same-photon custom extractions. S11 difference stack favors target against 3.88 arcsec TIC443106423 by SSE ratio 1.83, S65 ratio 0.99 and noisy; host unresolved. Gaussian fits descriptive only.

4646090.interpretation: Narrow dips at S4 BTJD1429.7868, S31 2148.7210 and 2159.4534; same-photon custom extraction depths 0.63%, 0.59%, 0.64%. Two-sector target fixed-source fits favor nearest capable TIC4646088 at 6.96 arcsec with SSE ratios 5.34 and 5.65; individual ratios 5.34, 3.57, 4.27. Gaussian fits descriptive, not calibrated confidence; geometry evaluated separately.

60443793.interpretation: Repeated alternating narrow minima spacing 1.29738064 d, candidate binary period 2.5947613 d, distinct from Gaia 6.51 d. Two-sector difference image strongly favors TIC60443695 at 59.38 arcsec, candidate bycatch, over target (neighbor/target SSE 0.0032 and 0.0229). Model scores descriptive, not formal significance; source identity remains conditional. Reject target association, not the real EB signal.
